Lines 101–103, variable n:
0=all/1=top/2=bottom
1为上面，有blink(1)字样；
2为下面，有thingM商标；

This is the project's original research record, not a manufacturer quotation.
Official ThingM documentation independently confirms LED 1=top and LED 2=bottom:
https://thingm.com/blog/2017/12/using-the-blink1-mk2-led-strip-adapter
